label: Guided-task roadmap: the robot's map (it knows the roads, never goal B). Read by Python (hri_control.py) and by the Unity builder (Tools > Warehouse HRI > Add Worker and Roadmap), so both use the same nodes.
declared: 2026-10-20; positions in the open aisles of the generated warehouse (rack centres at x = -12.5, 0, 12.5 and z = -15, -5, 5, 15), validated on the AMR NavMesh by the builder.
frame: Unity floor coordinates x, z in m (y up). Branch commands are relative to the arrival direction (previous node -> junction), from the robot's point of view.

worker_stand.rule: The worker stands corner_offset_m ahead and corner_offset_m to the right of the junction (arrival direction), facing the arriving robot. Unity scenario side only; the robot finds the worker by vision.
